title: Lane TEU Budget
summary: The per-lane compute allowance (~20,000 TEU/s default) keeping resource usage predictable and fair. TEU budgets work with SFQ scheduling to ensure every data space receives a minimum service level while preventing any single user or application from monopolizing lane capacity.
